shortDescription: Create or delete an API token for an existing admin user

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the admin user to create API token for.

options.name: recreate
options.description: Recreates the API token, overwriting the existing API token if present

options.name: timeout
options.description: The duration of API token validity. Valid values are weeks (w), days(d), hours(h), minutes(m) and seconds(s).

options.name: username
options.description: Username of the admin user to create API token for
